The resort, located in the heart of Key West on the Gulf of Mexico, will continue to be managed by Hyatt under a new management agreement. Hyatt Key West Resort and Spa (Photo: Business Wire) "We are extremely pleased to have added Hyatt Key West Resort and Spa to our portfolio, said Marcel Verbaas, president and CEO of Inland American Lodging Advisor, Inc.
